name: How do professionals clean up sewage in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals clean up sewage in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional sewage cleanup involves several critical steps. First, technicians safely extract all contaminated water and remove unsalvageable porous materials like drywall and carpeting. Next, they thoroughly clean and sanitize all affected hard surfaces using industrial-grade disinfectants to eliminate bacteria and pathogens. This is followed by drying the area with specialized equipment to prevent mold growth. Finally, air scrubbers are used to purify the air and remove any lingering odors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals extract contaminated water, remove unsalvageable materials, thoroughly clean and disinfect surfaces, dry the area, and purify the air.
